title: Higher Direct Images of the Structure Sheaf Over a Dedekind Domain
summary: We prove that for Noetherian, smooth, separated, integral, finite type schemes $X$ and $Y$ over an excellent Dedekind domain $R$, that are properly birational over $R$, we have $R^if_{*}\mathcal{O}_X \cong R^ig_{*} \mathcal{O}_Y$ and $R^i f_{*}Ω_{X/S}^{d} \cong R^ig_{*} Ω_{Y/S}^d$, where $d$ is the relative dimension of $X$ and $Y$ over $S= Spec(R)$, and $f$ and $g$ are the structure maps of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, as $S$-schemes. As a corollary we obtain the vanishing of higher direct images of the structure sheaf for proper birational morphisms beteween such schemes. These results…
